source.title: WEC Leader Announcement (November 2020)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Blake Thompson will become the new Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee (WEC). Blake was already working as a Senior Member of the WEC.

Blake was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Callum Goodyear for the work he has done for the WEC as the Leader, and wish Blake Thompson best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The Board received applications from the following applicants:

* Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
* Blake Thompson 
* Enzo Mattos
* Raúl Morales Hidalgo
 
We thank the other candidates for applying and their documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1is3G9e2TpX7pmgr5lERtbMzv0Kr_QW59).

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会负责人任命公告（2020 年 11 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Blake Thompson 将成为 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）的新负责人。Blake 此前已担任 WEC 高级成员。

按照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节的规定，WCA 董事会选定 Blake，并由现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票通过。

感谢 Callum Goodyear 担任 WEC 负责人期间所做的工作，祝 Blake Thompson 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

董事会收到以下申请者的材料：

* Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
* Blake Thompson
* Enzo Mattos
* Raúl Morales Hidalgo

感谢其他候选人的申请，申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1is3G9e2TpX7pmgr5lERtbMzv0Kr_QW59)查看。
